actions.action: Repot into a large, well-draining pot with gritty soil
Check that the soil has dried down 2 inches before watering
Give the plant a thorough soak once the soil is dry
Place the plant in full sun
Move the plant to shade on extremely hot days
Pot up to a larger container as the plant grows

verdict.reason: The answer, which appears to be scraped generic rosemary/lavender comments, warns only against overwatering and praises neglect, so it misses the confirmed underwatering in fast-drying terracotta, never suggests plastic pots or more water, and its 'neglect is best' advice would likely delay the fix.
